valueNote: Mostly a sourced timeline of the draft, Summer League and the two injury reports, with the nationality disagreement stated and both sources cited. Only NBA.com is a primary source; the rest is press, so the page adds little beyond the top results except the dated injury timeline and the flagged source conflict. Voice is plain, no hype words, no em dashes, no exclamation marks. Quote-heavy, which reads as stitched press quotes in places.
summary: All 49 claims (person_json facts, frontmatter, FAQ and body) were checked against the 12 sources opened with WebFetch. Every claim is confirmed. WebFetch returns model-summarised extracts rather than raw text, so quotes were checked against those extracts. No outdated claims: sources are dated 2026-06-23 to 2026-10-28, and web_search was not needed. No uncited claims. The metaTitle {age} placeholder is accepted per editor note. The nationality FAQ and body are supported by both cited sources.
